claim.claim-text: 1. A tip part for an insertable vision device, such as an endoscope, said tip part comprising

a housing accommodating an electronic vision receptor (10), at least one light guide (15) of a transparent material, the at least one light guide (15) configured to provide total internal reflection and having a predetermined length between a light reception end and a light emission end (17) adapted to emit light, wherein the housing comprises a first housing part (6), made of a first transparent material, and a second housing part (7), made of a second material; wherein the predetermined length comprises an expanding sector, and wherein the cross-sectional area is increasing in the longitudinal direction from the light reception end towards the light emission end, characterized in that the cross-sectional area has, along at least a part of the predetermined length, the shape of a rectangle.
2. A tip part according to claim 1, wherein said at least one expanding sector comprises a truncated pyramid.
3. A tip part according to any one of claims 1 or 2, wherein the rectangle has rounded corners.
4. A tip part according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein the rectangular cross-section as is present along the entire length of the light guide (15).
5. A tip part according to any one of the preceding claims wherein at least the expanding sector of said light guide is surrounded by air.
6. A tip part according to any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein at least a part of the light guide (15) is cladded with a cladding.
7. A tip part according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein the light reception end is adapted to engage an LED.
8. A tip part according to any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein the light reception end is adapted to engage a light fibre.
9. A tip part according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein the first light reception end comprises an end face with an essentially plane surface perpendicular to the longitudinal direction.
10. A tip part according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein the transparent material comprises polycarbonate.
11. An insertable vision device, such as an endoscope, with a tip according to any one of the preceding claims.
